sequence.result: Successfully resized window containing tab 753686640 to 768x1024 pixels

interpretation: Chrome extension resize_window resizes the OS window but the rendered page reports window.innerWidth=1920 — likely the OS window cannot shrink below the user's monitor minimum on this machine, OR resize_window only affects the browser chrome not the inner viewport. iPad-Mini layout was NOT actually exercised at 768px.
remediation_paths: Install Playwright in sandbox with proper mobile-emulate (chromium.devices['iPad Mini'])
Use Chrome DevTools Protocol Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride via chrome.debugger — PARENT §2 says this 'DOES NOT WORK' in cowork
Manually override window dimensions via JS — does NOT affect responsive breakpoints
load_bearing: this report's iPad-Mini-specific layout claims (truncate, no horizontal overflow, etc.) are extrapolations from desktop-width DOM + source/Tailwind class inspection, NOT measured at 768px
